an8.19:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā verañjāyaṃ viharati naḷeru pucimanda mūle.
an8.19:1.2: atha kho pahārādo asurindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho pahārādaṃ asurindaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.19:2.1: api pana pahārāda, asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantīti.
an8.19:2.3: kati pana pahārāda, mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantīti.
an8.19:2.4: aṭṭha bhante, mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti
an8.19:2.6: mahāsamuddo bhante, anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyatakeneva papāto.
an8.19:2.7: yampi bhante, mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyatakeneva papāto,
an8.19:2.8: ayaṃ bhante, mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati.
an8.19:3.2: yampi bhante, mahā samuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati,
an8.19:3.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahāsamudde dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati, yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippaṃyeva tīraṃ vāheti, thalaṃ ussādeti
an8.19:4.2: yampi bhante, mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati. yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippaṃ yeva tīraṃ vāheti, thalaṃ ussādeti2.
an8.19:4.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahāsamudde tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ:
an8.19:5.2: gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī, tā mahā samuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.
an8.19:5.3: yampi bhante, yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.
an8.19:5.4: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati,
an8.19:6.2: yampi bhante, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati,
an8.19:6.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahāsamudde pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahā samudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso,
an8.19:7.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahā samudde chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano. tatrimāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ: muttā, maṇi, veḷuriyo, saṅkho, silā, pavāḷaṃ. rajataṃ, jātarūpaṃ, lohitaṅko, masāragallaṃ,
an8.19:8.2: yampi bhante, mahā samuddo bahuratano anekaratano. tatrimāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ muttā, maṇi, veḷuriyo, saṅkho, silā, pavāḷaṃ, rajataṃ, jātarūpaṃ, lohitaṅko, masāragallaṃ,
an8.19:8.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahāsamudde sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhante, mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso. tatrime bhūtā: timi timiṅgalā timirapiṅgalā, asurā, nāgā, gandhabbā. santi mahā samudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā.
an8.19:9.2: yampi bhante, mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso. tatirame bhūtā: timi, timiṅgalā timirapiṅgalā, asurā, nāgā, gandhabbā. santi mahā samudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, dviyojana …pe… tiyojana …pe… catuyojana …pe… pañcayojana satikāpi attabhāvā,
an8.19:9.3: ayaṃ bhante, mahā samudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:9.4: ime kho bhante, mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantīti.
an8.19:10.1: api pana bhante, bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti?
an8.19:10.3: kati pana bhante, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti, ?
an8.19:10.4: aṭṭha pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:10.6: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyata keneva papāto.
an8.19:10.7: evameva kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā. na āyatakene va aññā paṭivedho.
an8.19:10.8: yampi pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho.
an8.19:10.9: ayaṃ pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:11.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda, mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati,
an8.19:11.2: evameva kho pahārāda, yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamanti.
an8.19:11.3: yampi pahārāda, mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamanti.
an8.19:11.4: ayaṃ pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:12.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati. yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippaññeva tīraṃ vāheti, thalaṃ ussādeti.
an8.19:13.1: evameva kho pahārāda, yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño. antopūti avassuto kasambujāto. na tena saṅgho saṃvasati. atha kho naṃ khippaññeva sannipatitvā ukkhipati. kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno. atha kho so ārakāva saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena.
an8.19:13.2: yampi pahārāda yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, na tena saṅgho saṃvasati. atha kho naṃ khippaññeva sannipatitvā ukkhipati. kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno atha kho so ārakāva saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena.
an8.19:13.3: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:14.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda, yā kāci mahā nadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:14.2: evameva kho pahārāda, cattārome vaṇṇā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā, te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, ‘samaṇā sakyaputtiyā’ tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti,
an8.19:14.3: yampi pahārāda cattārome vaṇṇā khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā. te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, ‘samaṇā sakyaputtiyā’ tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.
an8.19:14.4: ayaṃ pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:15.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti. na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:15.2: evameva kho pahārāda, bahū cepi bhikkhu anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti. na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.
an8.19:15.3: yampi pahārāda, bahū cepi bhikkhu anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.
an8.19:15.4: ayaṃ pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:16.2: evameva kho pahārāda, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso,
an8.19:16.3: yampi pahārāda, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso,
an8.19:16.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:17.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda, mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatrimāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ, muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ.
an8.19:17.2: evameva kho pahārāda, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatrimāni ratanāni: seyyathīdaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
an8.19:17.3: yampi pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatrimāni ratanāni: seyyathīdaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
an8.19:17.4: ayaṃ pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:18.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahā samuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatrime bhūtā: timi timiṅgalā timirapiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā, santi mahā samudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā.
an8.19:18.2: evameva kho pahārāda, ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā: sotāpanno, sotāpatti phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmi phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmī phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno.
an8.19:18.3: yampi pahārāda, ayaṃ dhammavinaye mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatrime bhūtā, sotāpanno, sotāpatti phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmī phalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno,
an8.19:18.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:19.1: ime kho pahārāda, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhu imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
